summary: Record bounded owner-approved license exceptions for OpenTelemetry v1.45.0
details: Record six exact-component NOASSERTION license exceptions with authenticated owner approval references, reviewed on 2026-10-29 and expiring at the start of 2026-11-27 UTC.
Pin the approved exception material in the offline repository-policy guard while retaining authenticated live review verification and strict license and advisory decisions.
Link dependency references to the canonical exception policy instead of duplicating its current entry count.

compatibility.notes: Dependency admission policy only; runtime code, module selections and persistence contracts are unchanged. The feature adopting these components must incorporate the trusted base and pass every required check.

security: Exceptions bind exact component versions, reason, owner, review date and expiry to owner-authored GitHub records. License allowlists, advisory enforcement and live approval verification are unchanged.
limitations: The classifier cannot resolve the composition of the unchanged Apache-2.0 and BSD-3-Clause license text; the exceptions do not assert a legal interpretation or SPDX composition. Preserve upstream notices and reassess future versions.
The current exception format covers each exact component identity across origins; these are not application-only exceptions. Expiry is not extended automatically.
